idea-plugin.name: BunnyLoader Mod SDK
idea-plugin.description: Create desktop C# BunnyLoader mods and ModItems using installed dotnet templates. Native Rider New Solution wizard with theme-aware controls, live Mod icon/name/author/version preview and automatic solution generation. Requires .NET 10 SDK and blmod / blitem templates. Uses BunnyLoader.ModSdk 0.1.1.

action.description: Create a ModItem in the selected directory
